summary: Lease Portal — Live Rent Comparison Panel — patient-centric conversational assistant.
requirement_text:
Organisation: CBRE — Advisory & Transaction Services (India)
Segment: Commercial Real Estate — Office Leasing Advisory

AI SUGGESTED & EDITED PARAMETERS:
APP TYPE: Interactive Comparison Panel (Web Feature within existing Lease Portal)
SEGMENT: Commercial Real Estate — Office Leasing Advisory
PROBLEM STATEMENT: CBRE brokers currently prepare client-facing lease comparison analyses manually in PowerPoint and Excel, which is slow, inconsistent across brokers, and difficult to update live during client meetings.
PROPOSED SOLUTION: Develop a live rent comparison panel integrated into the existing CBRE Lease Portal, enabling brokers to select three shortlisted buildings and display a dynamic side-by-side comparison across four key dimensions of lease offers.
KEY FEATURES: Real-time comparison of buildings across rent per sq ft, landlord concessions, lease terms, and fit-out costs.,Live adjustment of lease terms, escalation, tenant improvement allowance, and fit-out spec level with real-time recalculation.,Ability to save the current comparison state as a shareable PDF and trace recalculated numbers to their sources for audit purposes.
DATA SOURCES TO INTEGRATE: CBRE's internal Lease Por
